pad thai.reason: Traditionally made with fish sauce and dried shrimp. Ensure you ask for 'Jay' (vegan) preparation.

som tum.reason: Papaya salad usually contains fish sauce and dried shrimp. Ask for 'Som Tum Thai' without shrimp/fish sauce, or 'Som Tum Jay'.

green curry.reason: Curry paste often contains shrimp paste (kapi) and fish sauce.

mango sticky rice.reason: Coconut milk based, usually vegan. Verify no condensed milk was added.

dal makhani.reason: 'Makhani' means buttery. This dish typically contains cream and butter/ghee.

dal tadka.reason: Yellow lentils tempered with spices. Usually oil-based, but ask if ghee was used.

naan.reason: Dough often contains yogurt or milk, and is brushed with butter. Roti/Chapati is a safer vegan option.

pho.reason: Broth is typically bone-based with fish sauce. Look for 'Pho Chay' (Vegetarian Pho).

banh mi.reason: May contain pâté (meat paste) and mayonnaise. Ask for 'Banh Mi Chay' without mayo.

miso soup.reason: Traditional dashi stock is made from bonito (fish) flakes. Ask if it uses kombu (kelp) dashi.

tempura.reason: Batter may contain eggs. Dipping sauce usually contains dashi (fish).
